title: Redefine press-abort flow and accessible spinner-aside pattern for compact and icon buttons
creator: Maya Singh
description: Problem: Multiple product teams reported regressions where icon and compact buttons either replaced their label with a spinner (causing layout shift), collapsed hit targets during loading, or prevented users from cancelling long-press gestures. These behaviors regress accessibility and create inconsistent affordances between large and compact surfaces. Scope: redesign the in-button loading pattern so the spinner sits 'aside' (non-disruptive), preserve hit areas and touch targets across sizes, provide a unified abort/cancel interaction for optimistic actions, and make the pattern theme-aware (dark/light/high-contrast). This ticket covers the design spec, accessibility testing, and handoff assets for engineering to implement the pattern across primary/secondary/ghost/icon and split buttons. Out of scope: full analytics instrumentation (tracked in ENG-22711).
acceptance_criteria: Spinner-aside is specified and documented for primary, secondary, ghost, compact and icon-only buttons (no content replacement)
When loading, button width and layout must not shift beyond 2px visual tolerance; content should remain stable
Hit target size (tap area) must remain >= 44px for mobile for all variants even when compact visual size is smaller
There is a keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible cancel/abort gesture for long-running actions (aria-label + role announced)
High contrast and dark theme variants show spinner and label with sufficient contrast and meet WCAG AA for text and spinner visible cues
Design tokens updated to include spinner placement token, spinner-color tokens per variant, and a cancel affordance token
Figma spec, redlines, and a small interactive prototype are provided; engineering PR with implementation notes is linked
Regression test plan created and included in the PR checklist (visual snapshots + a11y checks)
design_notes: Preferred pattern: spinner-aside to the right of label for LTR and left for RTL; for icon-only buttons, place spinner offset outside the icon circle (prevent overlap)
Use token: button.spinner.offset = 8px; token can scale for compact vs comfortable density
Introduce a new affordance: soft-cancel (hold the button or press ESC) — adding aria-describedby to convey 'press ESC to cancel' on keyboard focus
For optimistic actions, show subtle microcopy 'Undo' as a toast rather than blocking initial action; only use cancel when server-side abort possible
Provide two visual states for loading: pending (micro-spinner + subtle opacity) and blocked (full spinner with disabled semantics)
Avoid replacing label text with spinner to prevent layout shift and context loss for screen reader users
decisions: Do not reintroduce label-replacement loading -- chosen spinner-aside to minimize CLS and preserve semantics
Maintain full hit target via invisible padding rather than increasing visual chrome for compact variants
Expose spinner placement and color as tokens to allow per-product overrides without forking the component
Provide a standardized ARIA pattern: role='status' on spinner container with aria-live='polite' for updates, and a distinct aria-label for cancel action
tradeoffs: Spinner-aside increases CSS complexity for tight layout edge cases (requires absolute positioning fallback) — chosen because accessibility and stability outweigh the styling cost
Keeping hit targets via invisible padding may slightly complicate layout boxes for grid-based lists, but preserves usability on touch devices
Providing cancel semantics requires coordination with backend abort APIs; where not available we fall back to optimistic undo messaging
